name: ahoo-skills
description: Codex and Claude Code skills marketplace for Ahoo-Wang open source projects

plugins.name: ahoo-agent-skills
plugins.description: General Ahoo agent skills that are maintained directly in this repository

plugins.name: ahoo-coapi-skills
plugins.description: CoApi skills for building and testing Spring HTTP Interface client proxies with reactive WebClient, synchronous RestClient, and Spring Cloud LoadBalancer support.

plugins.name: ahoo-cocache-skills
plugins.description: Agent Skills for downstream Java/Kotlin applications built on CoCache, the two-level coherent cache (local Caffeine in front of shared Redis): declaring, testing, reviewing and debugging caches, invalidation after commit, Spring Cache, JoinCache and SetCache; upgrading from CoCache 5.x to 6.x; and implementing CoherenceBackend extensions that pass the cocache-test TCK.

plugins.name: ahoo-cosec-skills
plugins.description: CoSec skills for integrating a reactive multi-tenant RBAC and policy-based security framework, authoring authorization policy documents, extending CoSec, and troubleshooting access decisions.

plugins.name: ahoo-cosid-skills
plugins.description: CosId 5 skills for choosing and integrating distributed ID generators: snowflake, cosid80, segment and periodic-segment strategies, the CosIdRuntime, Spring Boot configuration, leased machine slots on JDBC/Redis/MongoDB/ZooKeeper/cosid-server, and sharding.

plugins.name: ahoo-fetcher-skills
plugins.description: Skills for building with the Fetcher TypeScript ecosystem: the core HTTP client, decorator services, typed event buses, persisted storage, SSE/LLM streaming, OpenAI chat completions, OpenAPI types, React hooks and CoSec authentication, plus upgrading from Fetcher 5.x to 6.0. Wow CQRS clients and OpenAPI client generation live in the Wow repository's skills.

plugins.name: ahoo-fluent-assert-skills
plugins.description: Skills for writing Kotlin tests with FluentAssert's AssertJ-backed .assert() extensions for JDK types, nullable values, exceptions, and custom AssertProvider assertions.

plugins.name: ahoo-simba-skills
plugins.description: Skills for using and testing Simba, a JVM leader-election and distributed-lock library with JDBC (MySQL, PostgreSQL), Redis, and Zookeeper backends.

plugins.name: ahoo-wow-skills
plugins.description: Agent Skills for downstream applications built on Wow, the reactive DDD, Event Sourcing and CQRS framework: building, reviewing and debugging Wow services, breaking migrations, TypeScript clients generated from OpenAPI or written by hand, answering business data questions from a running service's read-only queries, and writing and hosting Wow View Engine views.
